title: ESP32-advanced_http_server: an HTTP server for UART messages
description: An ESP32 program that joins a Wi-Fi network, reads messages on UART 1, and serves the latest one over HTTP. Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
